bio.title: BIOGRAPHY
bio.subtitle: DJ • PRODUCER • FOUNDER OF INDUSTRIAL GIRLS
bio.statement: Born in Bogotá, Colombia, ANDHRAY is a DJ, producer, and creative director forging a singular sonic identity since 2018. Her sound is an immersive universe where dark hypnosis, direct acid frequencies, and seductive grooves converge on the dancefloor.
bio.collective: In 2019, she founded Industrial Girls, an independent record label, event concept, and agency dedicated to empowering female talent across the underground electronic circuit.
bio.soundDescription: Her propulsive techno —rooted in hard-hitting hypnotic percussion, analog acid lines, and sensual tension— is conquering the most demanding clubs across Europe and South America, highlighted by performances at BAUM Festival, Ritvales Medellín, Sensor Festival, Radikal Styles, F2F Napoli, among others.
